text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Esso cuts petrol prices in Portugal by three escudos per litre in apparent response to promotion campaign by Petrogal.
- Bank of Portugal and National Statistics Institute at odds over private consumption. Former say it is rising, the latter says it is not.
- Thousands found themselves facing demands for taxes already paid through the post office which had been slow in transferring the money to the authorities.
- Grundig sticks by decision to dismiss 114 workers today. About 1500 workers occupied the company's factory in Braga, in northern Portugal, protesting against the decision.
- German electricity company RWE is the most recent candidate to be a strategic partner of EDP - Electricidade de Portugal. The other candidate is Spanish company, Endesa.
- The number of unemployed people to benefit from unemployment subsidies has risen, indicating a rise in structural unemployment, the Social Security said.
- The government is going to sell off some armed forces property, beginning with some buildings in the centre of Lisbon.
